fit_scope: All remaining observations after whole-study removal from full target-specific dataset; not the original 80% split

shap.grouping: Sum signed one-hot contributions by unique internal name prefix; numeric columns mapped by exact name
shap.ensemble: arithmetic mean of three fixed realisations; sample SD ddof=1

AD.reference: all remaining observations after P15 removal
AD.distance: Euclidean in median-imputed standard-scaled numeric + constant-imputed dense one-hot categorical representation
AD.threshold: linear 0.95 quantile of reference self-excluded mean-five distances; duplicate rows retained
